view.reconstruction_sql: SELECT SUM("sv_reconstruct"."m0") AS "total_net_value" FROM (SELECT "o"."c_pqjjha" AS "c0", "o"."gross_value" AS "c1", "r"."c_wqnmzs" AS "c2", "r"."total_refunds" AS "c3", "o"."gross_value" - COALESCE("r"."total_refunds", 0) AS "m0" FROM (SELECT "r_ywzvwk"."c_pqjjha" AS "c_pqjjha", ("r_ywzvwk"."c_nnupji" * "r_ywzvwk"."c_fsaufx") / 100.0 AS "gross_value" FROM "r_ywzvwk" AS "r_ywzvwk" WHERE "r_ywzvwk"."c_zmccht" = :sv_text_0 AND NOT "r_ywzvwk"."c_nnupji" IS NULL) AS "o" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "r_xjsuyx"."c_wqnmzs" AS "c_wqnmzs", SUM("r_xjsuyx"."c_sarntu") / 100.0 AS "total_refunds" FROM "r_xjsuyx" AS "r_xjsuyx" GROUP BY "r_xjsuyx"."c_wqnmzs") AS "r" ON "o"."c_pqjjha" = "r"."c_wqnmzs") AS "sv_reconstruct"
view.source_sql:
SELECT SUM(o.gross_value - COALESCE(r.total_refunds, 0)) AS total_net_value
FROM (
  SELECT 
    c_pqjjha,
    (c_nnupji * c_fsaufx) / 100.0 AS gross_value
  FROM r_ywzvwk
  WHERE c_zmccht = 'web' AND c_nnupji IS NOT NULL
) o
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT 
    c_wqnmzs,
    SUM(c_sarntu) / 100.0 AS total_refunds
  FROM r_xjsuyx
  GROUP BY c_wqnmzs
) r ON o.c_pqjjha = r.c_wqnmzs;

SELECT AVG(net_value) AS answer
FROM (
  SELECT 
    o.c_pqjjha,
    (o.c_nnupji * o.c_fsaufx) / 100.0 - COALESCE(ref.ref_sum / 100.0, 0) AS net_value
  FROM r_ywzvwk o
  INNER JOIN r_jkuwkm p ON o.c_hdcpyd = p.c_yhbkuk AND p.c_apxrct = 1
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT c_wqnmzs, SUM(c_sarntu) AS ref_sum
    FROM r_xjsuyx
    GROUP BY c_wqnmzs
  ) ref ON o.c_pqjjha = ref.c_wqnmzs
  WHERE p.c_caakje = 'South'
    AND o.c_nnupji IS NOT NULL
)

WITH gold_customers AS (
  SELECT c_yhbkuk
  FROM r_jkuwkm
  WHERE c_apxrct = 1 AND c_rvtnvx = 'Gold'
),
order_gross AS (
  SELECT 
    o.c_pqjjha,
    (o.c_nnupji * o.c_fsaufx) / 100.0 AS gross_value
  FROM r_ywzvwk o
  INNER JOIN gold_customers gc ON o.c_hdcpyd = gc.c_yhbkuk
  WHERE o.c_nnupji IS NOT NULL
),
order_refunds AS (
  SELECT 
    c_wqnmzs AS c_pqjjha,
    COALESCE(SUM(c_sarntu) / 100.0, 0) AS total_refunds
  FROM r_xjsuyx
  GROUP BY c_wqnmzs
)
SELECT AVG(og.gross_value - COALESCE(or2.total_refunds, 0)) AS avg_net_value
FROM order_gross og
LEFT JOIN order_refunds or2 ON og.c_pqjjha = or2.c_pqjjha;

view.reconstruction_sql: SELECT AVG("sv_reconstruct"."m0") AS "avg_net_value" FROM (SELECT "_0"."c_yhmqfk" AS "c0", "_0"."gross_val" AS "c1", "_0"."c_mzrizp" AS "c2", "_0"."refund_sum" AS "c3", "_0"."gross_val" - COALESCE("_0"."refund_sum", 0) AS "m0" FROM (SELECT "o"."c_yhmqfk" AS "c_yhmqfk", "o"."c_ympufe" * "o"."c_juqdby" AS "gross_val", "o"."c_mzrizp" AS "c_mzrizp", COALESCE(SUM("r"."c_kwmbsx"), 0) AS "refund_sum" FROM "r_wrtnar" AS "o" LEFT JOIN "r_imudjs" AS "r" ON "o"."c_yhmqfk" = "r"."c_apczvk" WHERE NOT "o"."c_ympufe" IS NULL AND "o"."c_mzrizp" = :sv_text_0 GROUP BY "o"."c_yhmqfk", "o"."c_ympufe", "o"."c_juqdby", "o"."c_mzrizp") AS "_0") AS "sv_reconstruct"

SELECT AVG(gross_val - COALESCE(refund_sum, 0)) AS avg_net_value
FROM (
  SELECT 
    o.c_yhmqfk,
    o.c_ympufe * o.c_juqdby AS gross_val,
    o.c_mzrizp,
    COALESCE(SUM(r.c_kwmbsx), 0) AS refund_sum
  FROM r_wrtnar o
  LEFT JOIN r_imudjs r ON o.c_yhmqfk = r.c_apczvk
  WHERE o.c_ympufe IS NOT NULL
    AND o.c_mzrizp = 'store'
  GROUP BY o.c_yhmqfk, o.c_ympufe, o.c_juqdby, o.c_mzrizp
)
